paper.title: Communication-Efficient Gradient Descent-Accent Methods for Distributed Variational Inequalities: Unified Analysis and Local Updates

algorithm.name: ProxSkip-VIP-FL / deterministic ProxSkip-GDA-FL (Algorithm 2)
citations: PDF p.7, Section 4 and Algorithm 2 lines 1-13
assumptions: Each local saddle operator has positive definite symmetric part and is smooth.
Full deterministic operator is an unbiased zero-variance oracle.
Coin outcomes are fixed supported realizations of the stated Bernoulli law.
Initial worker points agree and initial control vectors sum to zero.
Finite trajectories only; no claim of proving communication complexity, nonmonotone theory, or loopless-SVRG variants.

cases.purpose: Exercise skip and communication branches with heterogeneous saddle operators and persistent nonzero control variates.

inputs.network: All workers communicate synchronously through one server; uniform averaging over every worker.
inputs.coordinates: Each row is worker state [u,v] for min_u max_v.
inputs.objective: Local saddle loss L_i(u,v)=A_i[0,0]*u^2/2+A_i[0,1]*u*v-A_i[1,1]*v^2/2+b_i[0]*u-b_i[1]*v. Operator g_i=[dL_i/du,-dL_i/dv]=A_i*[u,v]+b_i. Global saddle loss is the mean of local losses.
inputs.oracle: Use full deterministic local saddle operator at current x_i; no sampling noise.
inputs.randomness: Condition on exactly the listed server Bernoulli outcomes in chronological order; p=1/2. No extra draws.
inputs.observations: step s=t+1 denotes completion of lines 4-11 for the t-th listed coin. operator_used is evaluated at pre-update x; x_hat precedes communication; x and h follow line 11. mean_x is post-update uniform mean; communication_count includes this step.

parameters.loop_index_convention: Execute exactly four t values 0,1,2,3 (Algorithm 2 prints inclusive 0,...,T; set its T=3).
